sourceEvents.meaning: Prospective change to dated GO GAF/OBO provenance or derivative annotation; NO actual original GAF mutation
Prospective RFC source revision; NO actual publisher RFC revision

edgeScopes.why: GO original-source provenance concerns the GO child
HTTP publisher-source provenance concerns the HTTP child
GO evidence can change cross-publisher non-entailment witness applicability
HTTP semantics can change transport non-entailment witness applicability
Either source can require re-evaluating independent scope qualification
Parent/Root cannot silently remain qualified when a child or global invariant invalidates

semantics.graphAuthority: EV14 BLUEPRINT 'verificationPlanDag.edges' defines structural dependency pairs; edgeScopes annotate source-context selectors and must match those pairs exactly
semantics.sourceRevisionVsElementInvalidation: Independent source-byte identity stays unchanged for sibling publisher; impacted Element verification obligations can be invalidated without rewriting any source bytes
semantics.semanticGraphCycle: Allowed, but unrelated to executable DAG or dependency propagation; do not derive invalidation by traversing semanticLinks
semantics.policyRevision: If annotation policy changes, exact Git Blob pin invalidates verifier until explicitly reviewed; policy candidates cannot silently promote
semantics.noFalseCompleteness: Historical GO 36 rows represent bounded source samples, not full canonical GO KG; sourceEvents are hypothetical
semantics.elementSourceOwnership: EVERY semanticClaims.sourceRefs AND validationCases.sourceRefs MUST BE A SUBSET OF THE OWNING ELEMENT.sourceClaims; cross-element evidence must be represented as an explicit shared constraint dependency and cannot silently remain local-current.

correction.rule: Direct invalidation must be derived from actual Element sourceClaims, not an older hardcoded impact list.

impactSemantics.transitiveTopology: Blueprint.verificationPlanDag.edges only; policy.edgeScopes are scope annotations only
impactSemantics.invalidatedElementSap: For every impacted Element, invalidate its attached SAP profile, all its assurance obligations, CQ statuses and validation case currentness
impactSemantics.invalidatedOwnedConstraints: Derived from ownedConstraintRefs of impacted Element profiles
impactSemantics.dependentConstraintProfiles: Any Element profile referencing an invalidated owned constraint is marked DEPENDENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED; this does not claim its local source bytes changed
impactSemantics.unaffectedLocalProfiles: A sibling Element's local profile may remain source-current only if none of its sourceClaims changed; any shared/global constraint closure still requires review
impactSemantics.noPromotion: Invalidation and replay never authorizes SAP qualification, Root, Effects or R8
impactSemantics.invalidatedCompositionCases: When the event reaches Blueprint.root, invalidate every case in the CROSS_ELEMENT_COMPOSITION_ONLY validationBundle as a separate set; do not mix these with the 30 per-Element SAP case IDs.

changes: EV14-NONENTAILMENT now owns R33_NATIVE in sourceClaims and sourceSnapshot because NON-C02 and its validation cases cite R33_NATIVE.
EV14-HTTP-05 is now HTTP-local and no longer cites GO_SLICE_NATIVE; cross-publisher absence belongs to EV14-NONENTAILMENT.
sourceClosureRepair.invalidationConsequence: GO_EVIDENCE invalidates the NONENTAILMENT profile and its R33-dependent claims/cases; HTTP profile local cases no longer contain an undeclared GO source dependency.

compositionInvalidation.reason: The original eight-case bundle is separate from per-Element SAP cases; any source event that reaches Root invalidates the composed child/global state and must prevent stale bundle-case reuse.
